now: A hunt produces battles again. A party with no conscious member was a closed loop — `slotNear` refuses one, so no encounter starts, so no resolve runs, so `wipe()` (the only caller of `reviveAll`) is unreachable — and `wipe()` itself latched above its own revive, so the second wipe in a streak paid nothing and healed nobody and the save was silent and battle-free from then on. Fixed four ways over (DECISIONS #81): every wipe revives, a lap of the circuit revives, the city heals, and a save's hp is sanitised so a non-number cannot become the NaN none of those three can leave. The economy loop is still the open work: research, which every automation costs, cannot be minted from a fresh save, and loot cannot be sold by hand.

gate.baseline: docs/baseline.json — 1280x720, 17 regress rows, last accepted 39883bb; 0 moved on this branch

open.what: Research — the unlock currency of all ten automations — cannot be minted from a fresh save. It starts at 0 (economy/currencies.js); live wins credit money and BP only (encounter/index.js:1260, economy/index.js:219-223); the fold mints it only on a WON encounter (idle/accrual.js:396), a win needs flags.battle (:369), and that flag is granted only by the `hunt` automation (automation/index.js:227-236), which costs 120 research. The only economy.add('research', …) calls in src/ are grant:showcase lines — which is how the automations were 'verified'.
open.repro: npx vitest run src/idle/unlock.test.js — the it.fails case; or a fresh save, win fights, economy.balance('research') stays 0

open.what: There is no player-facing sell path. economy.sell() has exactly one caller, automation.runSell (automation/index.js:633), behind the research-priced 'sell' unlock; the shop panel only buys (ui/panels/shop.js); economy.stash()/bag() have no caller in src/ui. With research-unmintable, loot never becomes money in play, against CLAUDE.md's 'money is earned by selling'.

A closed tab's experience is computed into pending.exp (offline/index.js:278), shown as 'exp (held)' on the away card, and never granted: grantPartyExp is called only from idle/index.js:283 (a backgrounded tab) and encounter/index.js:1272. CLAUDE.md and ARCHITECTURE §0 say a closed tab mints experience.

The live shiny-odds check reads economy.count('shiny-charm') (encounter/index.js:264) but the item id is 'shinycharm' (economy/items.js:251), so a bought charm never affects a watched hunt. The fold path works: economy maps the purchase to idle's 'shiny-charm' unlock (economy/index.js:67).

The closed-tab catch-up always simulates the meadow: offline.decide() runs at init before any scene exists, terrain.handle() is null, and idle falls to own.biome ?? DEFAULT_BIOME (idle/index.js:107); own.biome is set only by idle.setBiome(), which has no callers, and is not in idle's save snapshot. The saved scene is never consulted.
open.repro: grep -rn 'setBiome' src | grep -v 'selftest\|showcase'  # only the definition

open.what: config.turnSteps (core/config.js:193) is read by nothing; the visible fight steps every T.TURN = 24 sim steps, a literal (encounter/index.js:116), and the comment at :109 claiming an override is false. Three documents repeated the claim.
open.repro: grep -rn 'turnSteps' src | grep -v core/config.js  # one comment, no reader

open.what: A watched, won battle credits money directly — rewardsFor pays 8×(1+level×0.16), ×1.5 on a catch, ×6 shiny (encounter/rolls.js:201-208; encounter/index.js:1260) — while the fold pays 0 (idle/accrual.js:387-393). Watched and unwatched hunts disagree on the rule ARCHITECTURE §0 states as 'money is earned by selling and from nowhere else'. One of the two is wrong; a decision is owed.

encounter/index.js:58 imports ./selftest.js for the browser selfTest(), so an 18.7 kB Node selftest chunk ships in the production bundle with node:fs, node:path and node:url externalised (three rolldown warnings in every build).
open.repro: npx vite build 2>&1 | grep externalized; ls dist/assets | grep selftest

open.what: economy.useItem() (economy/index.js:335) has zero consumers. The duel applies items through battle.applyAction on a combatant record, not on a pokemon instance, so the intent object it returns has no caller and the manual-use path is unbuilt.
The coast circuit runs through inland grass rather than along the shoreline: the loop's bend heuristic prefers path/tallgrass and the shore is neither.
open.repro: npm run shot -- --out shots/out/coast.png --showcase hunts --mode coast --tod 12 — and look at the route

open.what: travel.go() is serialised behind `busy` (travel/index.js:40,105,125) but not cancellable: once a scene starts building, the player waits for it.

Travelling mid-encounter calls encounter.cancel() with no prompt (travel/index.js:132) — a silent loss of a fight the player was in. cancel() also resolves nothing, so a party that fainted in that fight is written to the save unconscious; since slice 012 the city heals on arrival, so it is a lost fight rather than a dead save (DECISIONS #81). The prompt is still owed.
Accuracy and evasion stages are not modelled — deliberate and stated at battle/stats.js:42-43; only the five battle stats stage. Kept here so nobody rediscovers it as a bug.

economy/pacing.js MEASURED projects an income model DECISIONS #69 deleted and predates per-species drop tables and the ₽100,000 opening purse; its checkMeasured() is never called. The header says the table is stale; it is staler.

npm run assets depends on a PDSMS install hard-coded at tools/assets/build-tiles.js:25 (/Users/ericnantes/Downloads/…); on any other machine every set is 'skipped: missing', the script exits 0 having rebuilt nothing, and public/generated/tiles/index.json is rewritten to sets: [] (:263-266). .mcp.json and tools/props/adapt.py:29 carry absolute user paths too.

tools/shots/boot.js:56-65 discovers the matrix with one ?showcase=travel probe and exits 1 if that single shot fails; shoot() retries only navigation errors, not a __READY__ timeout, and the probe is the first request a freshly started vite serves (7.5–15 s cold compile, DECISIONS #71). Seen once on 2026-09-11: boot FAILED at 50 s with no per-case JSON written, green on the next two runs of the same tree. Intermittent.
open.repro: run `npm run gate` from a cold vite repeatedly; a boot failure with no shots/out/boot/*.json newer than the run is this

open.what: A backgrounded tab credits its experience to idle.totals() and to the away card whether or not the party can receive it. idle/index.js:283 hands gains.exp to pokemon.grantPartyExp, which filters `party.filter((p) => p.hp > 0)` (pokemon/index.js:281), so a party with nothing conscious in it banks nothing — while totals.exp, the digest and the toast all report the full amount. Measured at seed 1337 in hunt-meadow with the party at 0 hp: setHidden(true), advanceWallMs(3600000), pump() gave totals.exp 66739.25 over 57 encounters and party exp unchanged at [135,135,135]; the same hour on a healthy party granted it (exp [66873,66873,66873]). Money stayed 0 in both, so ARCHITECTURE §0's money rule is not involved. Related to closed-tab-exp-discarded, which is the offline half of the same asymmetry.
